entries.label: team_others_intercom_01
entries.text: Are you ready to challenge Team Star using the\nfirst three Pokémon in your party?

entries.label: team_others_intercom_02
entries.text: You’ve already defeated the boss of this base.\c\nDo you want to challenge Team Star again using\nthe first three Pokémon in your party?

entries.label: team_others_intercom_03
entries.text: Do you want to train at the STC using the first\nthree Pokémon in your party?

entries.label: team_others_intercom_08
entries.text: Do you want to challenge the boss of this\nTeam Star base again?

entries.label: team_others_intercom_04
entries.text: You can’t challenge Team Star without at least\nthree Pokémon in your party that can battle.

entries.label: team_others_intercom_07
entries.text: You can’t train at the STC without at least three\nPokémon in your party that can battle.

entries.label: team_others_intercom_05
entries.text: You don’t have enough Pokémon that will obey\nyou, so you can’t challenge Team Star.

entries.label: team_others_intercom_06
entries.text: You don’t have enough Pokémon that will obey\nyour commands, so you can’t train at the STC.
